name: Manual Sampler (override eta, s_noise, stages; savable presets)
plain: Wraps any sampler in the k-diffusion sampler table and calls it with eta, s_noise and stages overrides, dropping any the chosen sampler's signature does not accept. It adds no maths of its own, but it is the only way to reach the 3, 4 and 5-stage HFE integrators, since hfe_s* and hfe_auto take a stages argument that the normal sampler list never passes. eta_override -1 means keep the sampler's default; s_noise defaults to 1.0 and stages to 2 and are always passed when accepted. Saved presets are registered at startup as new sampler names 'manual_sampler_<name>'.
math:
sampler'(model, x, σ) = base(model, x, σ, **{eta: η if η ≥ 0, s_noise: s, stages: n} ∩ accepted_kwargs(base)).
If base takes **kwargs, everything is passed.

props.registers: saved presets as sampler names with prefix manual_sampler_ (stored in the pack's presets/manual_samplers.json)
